note: 2026-11-21 核对：1901-08-20西西里Modica生（铁路职工之子）—1968-06-14那不勒斯卒（66岁）；1959诺贝尔文学奖；'Originally a leader of the Hermetic poets, he became, after World War II, a powerful poet commenting on modern social issues.'；师从翁加雷蒂与蒙塔莱起步；1930年代'the dry, sophisticated style and abstruse symbolism of Hermeticism'；隐逸期终于 Poesie (1938) 与 Ed è subito sera (1942; And Suddenly Its Evening)；Acque e terre (1930)、Oboe sommerso (1932)、Odore di eucalyptus (1933)、Erato e Apollion (1936)；战后 Giorno dopo giorno (1947)——'Many of his poems recalled the injustices of the fascist regime, the horrors of the war, and Italian guilt.'——'simple in language, exhibit a concrete and immediate imagery'；La terra impareggiabile (1958) 题词——'I say that the dead slay the living'（埃斯库罗斯）；译希腊抒情诗 (1940)、希腊悲剧家 (1963)、卡图卢斯/奥维德/维吉尔、莎剧六种、莫里哀《答尔丢夫》、E.E.卡明斯与聂鲁达

title: Federico Garcia Lorca — Encyclopaedia Britannica
author: The Editors of Encyclopaedia Britannica
note: 2026-11-21 核对：1898-06-05格拉纳达省Fuente Vaqueros生—1936-08-18/19格拉纳达省Víznar与Alfacar之间卒（38岁）；1936-08-16被国民军逮捕、未经审判——'driven to a remote hillside outside town and shot'（国民军'abhorred his homosexuality and his liberal views'）；'the most important Spanish poet and playwright of the 20th century'——开启了西班牙戏剧'second Golden Age'；Romancero gitano（吉普赛谣曲, 1921-27写/1928出版）——18首谣曲——'sold out within a year; many readers mistook Lorca for a Gypsy'；Bodas de sangre（血婚, 1933）、Yerma (1934)、La casa de Bernarda Alba (1936)；Poet in New York——1929-30纽约古巴之行；1927纪year与阿尔贝蒂/希伦/萨利纳斯等纪念贡戈拉逝世300周年——此后被称'Generation of 1927'；Llanto por Ignacio Sánchez Mejías (1935)——悼斗牛士
